items.headline: Create on-brand content with your Figma designs in Weave workflows
items.excerpt: Figma's new Figma node lets you connect designs already made on the Figma Design canvas directly into Figma Weave generative workflows, so brand-accurate assets can be produced at scale and synced back when the source design changes.

items.headline: v0 now reads npm credentials from shared environment variables
items.excerpt: v0 can now install private packages from npm and custom registries, letting teams generate UI against their own internal design system packages instead of generic components.

items.headline: Figma Motion basics: Use shaders in your animations
items.excerpt: Figma walks through applying generative shaders inside Figma Motion, showing how prompt-generated visual effects become reusable animation layers in a design file.

items.headline: Over 85% of Japanese Game Developers Now Use Generative AI, According to TGS Report
items.excerpt: CESA reports that over 85% of Japanese game developers use generative AI at least occasionally, while studios prioritize human review, restricted tool lists and explicit usage policies.

items.headline: Quad Remesher for Hard-Surface & Organic Blender Models
items.excerpt: A user-friendly automatic retopology add-on from Milad Kambari that cuts polygon counts on both hard-surface and organic Blender models without manual cleanup.

items.headline: What is Photorealistic Rendering for Product Design?
items.excerpt: KeyShot breaks down what makes a product render read as a photograph and lays out a six-step build process for designers moving from CAD to final imagery.

items.headline: Backflip now converts 2D engineering drawings directly into CAD
items.excerpt: Backflip has launched 2D Drawing to CAD, an AI tool that turns legacy 2D drawings into parametric 3D models with native, editable feature trees rather than dumb solids.

items.headline: Artec Neo: the first 'tolerance-driven' 3D scanner launched
items.excerpt: Artec Neo promises to change quality inspection and reverse engineering for design teams with high-resolution, full-colour 3D capture tied to stated tolerances.

items.headline: Hololight pushes the Viz abilities of new Snap SPECS
items.excerpt: Hololight's XR streaming integration lets Snap SPECS display complex, high-fidelity 3D design data without heavy onboard processing, opening AR design review on lightweight glasses.

items.headline: Snap Announces New 'Anticipatory' AI Service & Apps for First Consumer 'Specs' AR Glasses
items.excerpt: Snap announced new experiences, services and partnerships for Specs, its upcoming consumer AR glasses, centred on an 'anticipatory' AI layer that surfaces content before the wearer asks.

items.headline: The Best Ways To View Gaussian Splats On Quest
items.excerpt: A practical guide to the apps and pipelines for stepping inside captured real places and generative-AI worlds as gaussian splats on Quest headsets.

items.headline: Flow Chaser Brings Procedural Spatial Rhythm Gameplay To Apple Vision Pro
items.excerpt: Flow Chaser is a new procedurally generated spatial rhythm game for Apple Vision Pro, launched alongside visionOS 27 and built around generated-on-the-fly spatial level design.

items.headline: The next phase of design will still be human-led
items.excerpt: Generative AI turns ideas into artefacts faster than ever, which Spotify's senior director of product design argues makes human judgement more important, not less: 'More is not always better. Faster is not always better.'

items.headline: "We can cut production costs by 95%": the AI tech taking on Hollywood
items.excerpt: Creative Bloq talks to the teams behind AI animation pipelines claiming they can strip up to 95% of production cost out of studio work, and what that does to creative roles.

items.headline: Massive Canva update adds 100 features to new ProSuite
items.excerpt: Canva's ProSuite release bundles roughly 100 new features, aiming to automate the tedious parts of production design while leaving the craft decisions to humans.

items.headline: Autodesk says AI should give artists time to experiment, not make them work twice as fast
items.excerpt: Autodesk argues the time AI saves an animator or artist should be reinvested in experimentation rather than absorbed as doubled throughput.

items.headline: Rethinking writing in the world of design and AI
items.excerpt: After 100 design essays written in the shadow of AI, the author reflects on what writing still does for a designer's thinking, and where friction is worth keeping.

items.headline: How an AI Filmmaker Built a Short Film in a Day With Astra and Runway
items.excerpt: A breakdown of a one-day AI film pipeline using GPT-6 Astra for story and boards, Codex for glue code, and Runway for shot generation.

items.headline: Claude Code Mods and agents.md: What's New and Why It Matters
items.excerpt: Claude Code now reads agents.md files and supports 'mods', a plugin system for customising the coding harness itself — a lever for design-engineering teams standardising their agent setup.

items.headline: Seedance 2.5 vs Kling 3.0 vs Minimax: Which AI Video Model Wins?
items.excerpt: A hands-on cost and quality comparison of Seedance 2.5, Kling 3.0 and Minimax on identical UGC video prompts, with pricing broken down per clip.

items.headline: The Chatbot Era Is Ending. Your AI Team Is Next.
items.excerpt: Argues the single-chatbot workflow is giving way to managed teams of specialised agents, and walks through how creative and knowledge workers should restructure around it.

items.headline: AI News: All AI Labs Want To Slow Down (Except One)
items.excerpt: Matt Wolfe's weekly roundup of new AI tools and model releases, including the creative-tool launches designers can pick up this week.
